Annotation.description: A person's note or override on a finding.
Annotation.title: Annotation

Attempt.description: One execution of a probe against the target.
Attempt.title: Attempt

Budget.description:
What the run was allowed and what it spent. ``attempts_per_probe`` is the most attempts any
probe planned. ``stopped_by`` names the limit that stopped the run.
Budget.title: Budget

Check.description:
A rule stated before the attack runs, which decides whether it succeeded. ``spec`` holds the
kind's own settings: the markers of a text check, the canary, the goal of a tool-call check, the
criteria of a judge.
Check.title: Check

CheckResult.description:
One check's verdict on one attempt. ``hit`` is ``None`` when the check could not decide: a
judge's answer was unreadable, or what it needed was not observed. That is never a pass.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Controls.description:
Negative controls: the probe run without the attack. ``passed`` held, ``failed`` showed the
signal, ``undetermined`` neither. ``evaluated`` is false when no control ran.
Controls.title: Controls

Counts.description:
A run's attempts by outcome, and its findings by strength. ``confirmed`` counts findings at
level 2 and above, ``attempted`` those whose strongest evidence is a tool call that did not run,
``suspected`` those a model judged only. They are never added together.
Counts.title: Counts

Evidence.description:
Raw evidence captured at a boundary the harness trusts: a reply, a tool call, a receipt, a
state diff. ``sha256`` is over ``content`` when the content is kept.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceLevel.description: How strong the evidence of an attempt is. A finding carries the highest level it reached.
EvidenceLevel.title: EvidenceLevel

Finding.description: What a run reports for a probe that reached evidence. Its label follows from its level.
Finding.title: Finding

FindingRow.description:
One finding as the report shows it. ``verification`` is the verification outcome,
``reproductions`` ``"r of n"`` and ``negative_control`` passed, failed or undetermined, each
``"not evaluated"`` when the run carries no such result.
FindingRow.title: FindingRow

GateOutcome.description:
The gate's result, when the report was written by a run that applied one: ``passed`` (exit
0), what failed it and what it only warns about.
GateOutcome.title: GateOutcome

Group.description: The attack attempts of one attack method or one vulnerability.
Group.title: Group

JudgeCalibration.description:
The judge measured on a labelled sample before the run. ``precision`` is its true positives
over all it called hits; ``recall`` its true positives over the sample's real hits. ``error`` says
why it could not be measured.
JudgeCalibration.title: JudgeCalibration

ModelInfo.description: A model the run called: its provider and name, and its settings.
ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

Outcomes.description:
The attack attempts by outcome. ``decided`` is hits plus resisted; every rate is over it.
``confirmed_hits`` reached level 2 or above (a tool call that only was asked for excepted),
``attempted_hits`` only a tool call that was asked for and not known to run, ``suspected_hits``
level 1 only.
Outcomes.title: Outcomes

Plant.description:
Content a probe plants in the world: an implant profile of the agent connection, admitted
with the run, and the text its writable fields take.
Plant.title: Plant

Probe.description: One planned test. Its checks are fixed before the attack runs.
Probe.title: Probe

Rate.description:
``successes`` of ``trials`` with its Wilson 95% interval (``low``, ``high``).

With no trial, every value is ``None``. With no success, ``rate`` is ``None`` and ``upper_bound``
is ``high``: zero successes bound the rate, they do not measure it as 0%. ``display`` is the text
every output shows.
Rate.title: Rate

RedteamReport.description:
The red team report standard (``redteam-report.json``). ``docs/redteam-reports.md`` defines
every field.
RedteamReport.title: RedteamReport

Refusals.description:
Generations the attacker refused to write or left empty, over all generations it was asked
for. A refused generation is never counted as a resisted attack.
Refusals.title: Refusals

RunOut.description: A run without its attempts and evidence, which are read page by page.
RunOut.title: RunOut

RunStart.description: Start a run from a version 2 run file, given as its parsed mapping.
RunStart.title: RunStart

RunSummary.description: A red team run in a listing.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

Spend.description:
What an attempt, a probe or a run spent: calls of the target, of the attacker model and of the
judge model, the tokens those model calls reported and their cost when it is known.
Spend.title: Spend

Success.description:
``per_attempt``: hits over decided attempts. ``within_k``: probes that hit within k target
queries over probes decided within them. ``queries_to_first_confirmed``: for each probe with a
confirmed hit, the target queries it took, as their median and largest value.
Success.title: Success

TargetRef.description: What was attacked, as the run describes it. No credential is ever kept here.
TargetRef.title: TargetRef

TaskCompletion.description: A probe's benign task, completed with and without the attack.
TaskCompletion.title: TaskCompletion

ToolCall.description:
One tool call the target made or asked for. ``executed`` is ``True`` when something that runs
the tool (a proxy, the agent's own dispatcher, a trace) saw it run, ``False`` when it was known
not to run (blocked), and ``None`` when only the request is known.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

Turn.description: One message of an attempt's conversation.
Turn.title: Turn

Verification.description: What a probe's repetitions and its negative control established.
Verification.title: Verification

Verifications.description: Each probe's verification outcome. ``evaluated`` is false when the run carries none.
Verifications.title: Verifications

WithinK.description:
Success within ``k`` target queries per probe. ``probes`` counts the probes an attempt
decided within those queries; ``undecided`` the rest.
WithinK.title: WithinK

app__redteam_environment_runs__SessionOu.description: What an agent binds its tools with: ``AssessmentSession`` in the SDK.
app__redteam_environment_runs__SessionOu.title: SessionOut

info.description: Every /v1/redteam route: the red team core's, and the hosted backend's SDK operation routes (operations contract version 2). Generated by scripts/redteam_contract.py; do not edit by hand.
info.title: Martian red team API
